svg.title: Three-color blends and one-stroke shapes
svg.text: Blend three neighbor colors across each box. Then paint over the gray shapes with a split-loaded flat brush. Lesson 08.1.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Split-cake test strokes: every stroke should show clean stripes
One-stroke shapes: paint over the gray, light corner on the dot
Free practice: one-stroke flower, leaves and a swirl without guides
